Hi Elena,

Great to meet you briefly on last week's call. We would love to do a targeted product preview for TideWave next week focused on the integration patterns we discussed. Two asks up front:

- Would TideWave have the VP of IS and the CIO available for a 30-minute executive preview? We find a short, focused session (20–30m) with a technical 1:1 immediately after helps decisioning.
- If possible, can you reserve a quiet room for a 1:1 with your CTO after the demo so our engineering lead can sync on integration constraints?

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue Apr 16, 09:30–10:00 or 14:00–14:30
- Wed Apr 17, 10:00–10:30 or 15:30–16:00

I attached a short demo agenda and a copy of the NDA we signed for reference. If those windows won't work, send a couple that do and we will adapt.

Thanks — excited to show how we can cut per-token inference cost for your search assistants while keeping sub-200ms p95 latency for end-users.

Best,
Ben Carter
